biggest_catch: The friend must complete 8 qualifying transactions within 60 days of opening, and the $100 doesn't land until about 75 days after account opening - a long qualification tail for the referrer too.
catches: Referring member must be 18+, in good standing, and primary on the account; submit the online referral form at www.expresscu.org/refer/.

Friend must: qualify for membership (live/work in Washington State; exceptions for immediate family), select 'Referral Campaign' as referral source at application, and not have been an ECU member in the past six months.

Friend opens a checking account + savings account + enrolls in Online Banking and completes 8 qualifying transactions (debit purchases, direct deposits, ACH, ATM, checks that clear) within 60 days of account opening.
Both accounts must remain open and in good standing for at least 60 days.
$100 deposited to both the referring member's and the new member's savings accounts within approximately 75 days of account opening.
No referral-count cap stated in the terms.
Tax: $100 reported as interest income (1099-INT) for the new member; may be reported on 1099-MISC for the referring member.

steps: Complete the online referral form at expresscu.org/refer/ with your name and your friend's name and email.
Express CU emails your friend information on how to open an account.
Friend joins, selects 'Referral Campaign' as referral source, opens checking + savings + online banking, and completes 8 qualifying transactions within 60 days.
$100 is deposited into your savings account within ~75 days of their account opening.
timing: $100 deposited to the referring member's savings within approximately 75 days of the new member's account opening, after activity review.
when_cash_arrives: $100 deposited to the referring member's savings within approximately 75 days of the new member's account opening, after activity review. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
